title: Python: simulation and gateway-flow integration
description:
Exercise the integrated Node through python/src/lichen/sim/node_server.py, python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py and python/src/lichen/radio/sim_client.py. Model finite RX chains, TX resources, passbands and demodulators explicitly; channel count is not concurrency. Gateway/client-originated traffic must reach the same radio-owned Node admission path. Reconnect and server registration must not reset applicable airtime restrictions.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing adapters and simulator event machinery, not a new benchmark framework or an idealized collision model used as proof. No dependency on admission tests, RF experiments or the vectors.12 consumer is required. Preserve upstream addresses, radio-owned identity, baseline SCHC/security, custody semantics and deferred portability. This production leaf authorizes no hardware port access, RF transmission or compliance claim.
acceptance_criteria: Use independent vectors.04/.08/.09 event traces through real simulation adapters and Node execution. Test single-radio conflicts, multiple RX chains with one TX chain, passband/demodulator exhaustion, shared receivers, overlapping roots, control loss, reconnect accounting and complete-operation overruns. Extend python/tests/sim/test_node_server.py, python/tests/sim/test_tdma.py and Node integration tests. Failed or zero-delivery scenarios remain failures with distinct latency/loss/airtime reporting. Run scoped pytest and ruff; record simulation evidence only.
